dogwood days
(noun)

the stretch of spring that represent the dogwood tree flower's short, ephemeral bloom.

Or: The hazy, melancholic comfort of holding onto sweet memories that have already begun to fade.

home base

a small house in charlotte, north carolina. working from home, producing from home, with a tall chocolate lab / Anatolian shepherd mix güd boy keeping me company.

what is the best concert you've been to?

in 2009, my grandparents brought me to see paul mccartney open the brand new citi field in queens, new york. my first memory ever was stopping and truly listening to “yesterday” by the beatles on a cd those same grandparents bought me. it was a true full-circle moment, and paul rocked the stadium so well they made a live album from it.

so what's your sound?

a lil' Mt. Joy. a lot o' John Mayer. a splash of Blind Pilot. a hint of The Dip. (secretly, i wish i sounded like weird al).

but whenever i sit down to write, it sounds like a dollop of indie-pop, a dash of soft rock, and a heap of singer-songwriter vibes.
